locked.name: Locked
locked.explanation: This element will be unlocked when the conditions are met.

maximum.name: Maximum
maximum.explanation: You may not possess or exercise more than this number.

purchase-limit.name: Purchase Limit
purchase-limit.explanation: The maximum number of times you can purchase.

purchasable-count.name: Purchasable
purchasable-count.explanation: The number of times you can still purchase.

navigation.name: Navigation
navigation.explanation: You can also move between columns by swiping. The top button is displayed at the bottom left of the screen.

navigation-column.name: Column
navigation-column.explanation: The position of this column and the total number of columns, including those outside the screen.

activity.name: Activity
activity.explanation: Lists the actions you can perform, grouped by category.

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.explanation: Lists the items you own, grouped by category.

status.name: Status
status.explanation: Shows the current state, such as the corrections applied to each category.

overview.name: Overview
overview.explanation: Shows the outline of this world and the console running it.

estimated-playing-time.name: Estimated Playing Time
estimated-playing-time.explanation: The time it takes to complete this world as estimated by the author

language-change-enable-general.name: Language Change Enable General
language-change-enable-general.explanation: You can change the display to another language in the configuration.

max-category-level.name: Max Category Level
max-category-level.explanation: The maximum level that can be achieved in each category.

level-common-ratio.name: Level Common Ratio
level-common-ratio.explanation: How much experience points are needed to reach the next level each time you gain a level.

console.name: Console
console.explanation: This game runs on the Idle RPG console system. It is free and open to the public, so anyone can create games.

statistics.name: Statistics
statistics.explanation: Shows the totals recorded through your play.

coin.name: Coin
coin.explanation: An item that serves as the currency for buying and selling.

amount-earned.name: Amount Earned
amount-earned.explanation: The total amount of coins you have earned so far.

playing-time.name: Playing Time
playing-time.explanation: The amount of time elapsed since you started playing this game, including offline time.

count-now.name: Count Now
count-now.explanation: The total number of items you currently own.

count-gained.name: Count Gained
count-gained.explanation: The total number of items acquired so far.

total-level.name: Total Level
total-level.explanation: The sum of the current levels of all categories.

count-actioned.name: Count Actioned
count-actioned.explanation: The total number of actions performed so far.

debug.name: Debug
debug.explanation: Provides the tools for testing a world. Available only in debug mode.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.explanation: Speeds up time in the game. Please note that if you increase the speed too much when the action execution time is slow, the processing will not be able to keep up and the app will freeze or crash.

skip.name: Skip
skip.explanation: Advances the game time at once without waiting.

skip-hour.name: Skip 1 Hour
skip-hour.explanation: Advances the game by one hour at once. The progress is processed in the same way as while you are away, and the results are shown as notifications.

adjustment.name: Adjustment
adjustment.explanation: Increases or decreases the number of items owned or the category level.

adjustment-category.name: Category
adjustment-category.explanation: Adjust the level of the category. For example, if you set it to +5, 5 levels will be added.

adjustment-action.name: Action
adjustment-action.explanation: This will increase or decrease the number of times the action has been performed. However, it will not reflect any rewards earned upon completing the action.

adjustment-item.name: Item
adjustment-item.explanation: Increases or decreases the number of items you own.

adjustment-id.name: ID
adjustment-id.explanation: Specify the ID of the target type. If left blank, the addition and subtraction will be adjusted for all IDs.

adjustment-count.name: Count
adjustment-count.explanation: The number to increase or decrease. Specify whether to increase or decrease with a symbol.

adjustment-adjust.name: Adjust
adjustment-adjust.explanation: Adjustments are made under the specified conditions.

iconify.name: Iconify
iconify.explanation: This game uses icon sets provided by iconify. I would like to thank everyone involved in the production.

standalone.name: Standalone
standalone.explanation: It runs independently, regardless of the progress of actions in other categories.

actions.name: Action List
actions.explanation: Lists the actions belonging to this category.

attribute.name: Attribute
attribute.explanation: Specific attributes of this action. Category properties are applied to this action's attributes. Experience points are also assigned to this attribute.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.explanation: You perform a series of actions, and each time you complete an action you get a reward.

single.name: Single
single.explanation: You can only perform an action once, and your progress will be saved even if you interrupt it midway.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.explanation: Each action reduces the stamina of the player and the target. When the target's stamina runs out, you win, and when the player's stamina runs out, the game is over. When the game is over, you have nothing to lose, but all action progress is interrupted.

act.name: Act
act.explanation: Starts and stops this action, and shows how far it has progressed.

reserve.name: Reserve
reserve.explanation: Add this action to the reservation queue for sequential execution.

reorder.name: Reposition
reorder.explanation: Move this reserved action to the selected position in the queue.

position.name: Execution Order
position.explanation: Select when to run this action. 0 runs it now, and 1 or later puts it into the waiting queue at that place.

now.name: Now
now.explanation: Run this action immediately instead of putting it into the waiting queue.

acquisition-failure.name: Acquisition Failure
acquisition-failure.explanation: Rewards marked with (-) are obtained only when the action fails.

items.name: Item List
items.explanation: Lists the items belonging to this category.

normal.name: Normal
normal.explanation: An ordinary item that you can own, equip, and trade.

capacity.name: Capacity
capacity.explanation: A special item that represents how many kinds of items you can own at the same time.

queue.name: Queue
queue.explanation: A special item that represents how many actions you can reserve for sequential execution.

equipment-type.name: Equipment
equipment-type.explanation: The equipment type of the item.

necessary-item.name: Necessary
necessary-item.explanation: Equipping the item will have effects.

unnecessary-item.name: Unnecessary
unnecessary-item.explanation: You cannot equip the item, but just having it in your possession will have effects. The effect is multiplied by the number you own.

consumable-item.name: Consumable
consumable-item.explanation: When equipped, it has an effect, but is consumed every time you take action.

buy.name: Buy
buy.explanation: The value of the item when buying.

buying-value.name: Buying Value
buying-value.explanation: The value of the item when buying.

sell.name: Sell
sell.explanation: The value of the item when selling.

selling.name: Selling
selling.explanation: Sells the items you own, chosen from a single list.

selling-value.name: Selling Value
selling-value.explanation: The value of the item when selling.

already-queued.name: Already Queued
already-queued.explanation: This action is already running or reserved.

completed-maximum.name: Completed Maximum
completed-maximum.explanation: You have reached the maximum number of completions.

properties.name: Property List
properties.explanation: Lists the properties applied to this category.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.explanation: Probability of receiving damage from monster.

speed.name: Speed
speed.explanation: Affects the speed of the action.

chance.name: Chance
chance.explanation: The action can be successful, but if it fails you will not receive any rewards or experience points.

experience.name: Experience
experience.explanation: Affects experience points gained from actions.

correction.name: Correction
correction.explanation: Corrections due to effects from equipment and items.

base-value.name: Base Value
base-value.explanation: A unique value for this game or action.

level-gap.name: Level Gap
level-gap.explanation: For numerical calculations, see the “Level” block.

reflected-value.name: Reflected Value
reflected-value.explanation: The final calculated value based on "Base Value" and "Level Gap".

level-gap-property.name: Level Gap Property
level-gap-property.explanation: The “Level Gap” value is the sum of each value within this block.

level-gap-category.name: Level Gap Category
level-gap-category.explanation: The level of the player's category minus the level of this action. In the case of "experience", the situation is reversed.

level-gap-action.name: Level Gap Action
level-gap-action.explanation: When the progress type is stamina, this is the unique value this action sets.

level-gap-item.name: Level Gap Item
level-gap-item.explanation: This is the correction value from equipped items, or from items that have an effect even if not equipped.

targeting-all-categories.name: Targeting All Categories
targeting-all-categories.explanation: This property correction applies to all categories.

comebacked.name: Comebacked
comebacked.explanation: Welcome back! Progress while you were away:

gameovered.name: Gameovered
gameovered.explanation: Game over. Your progress has been reset.

completed.name: Completed
completed.explanation: Congratulations! You have completed all categories.

receive.name: Receive
receive.explanation: Receive the reward for this task.

received.name: Received
received.explanation: The reward for this task has already been received.

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.explanation: Once you have confirmed the content, this column will be hidden.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.explanation: Lists the tasks set for this category.

missions.name: Missions
missions.explanation: Lists the tasks of every category and whether each one has been achieved.

config.name: Config
config.explanation: Changes the settings of this game and manages your saved data.

display.name: Display
display.explanation: Changes how the game is shown on the screen.

language.name: Language
language.explanation: Changes the language used for the display.

language-change-enable.name: Language Change Enable
language-change-enable.explanation: You can change the language displayed.

language-change-unenable.name: Language Change Unenable
language-change-unenable.explanation: There are no other languages ​​available to display.

category-shortcut.name: Category Shortcut
category-shortcut.explanation: When you open a category, the Action List or Item List will also be displayed.

showing-navigation.name: Navigation
showing-navigation.explanation: Displays buttons for moving between columns. You can also swipe to move between columns without displaying them.

performance.name: Performance
performance.explanation: Adjusts how the console runs on your device.

performing-highly.name: Performing Highly
performing-highly.explanation: Increases the update frequency. If the operation is heavy, we recommend turning it off. It does not affect the execution time of each action.

data.name: Data
data.explanation: Saves, loads and erases the progress data of this world.

export-game.name: Export Game
export-game.explanation: The game data has been exported.

import-game.name: Import Game
import-game.explanation: The game data has been imported.

reset-game.name: Reset Game
reset-game.explanation: Deletes all progress data for this world. This action cannot be undone. Please confirm that you really want to delete the file, then enter 'DELETE' in the input field. (Not required in debug mode)

reset-alert.name: Reset Alert
reset-alert.explanation: Resetting the game will erase all data. Are you sure you want to reset the game?

reset-debug-mode.name: Reset Debug Mode
reset-debug-mode.explanation: In debug mode, no input is required in the confirmation field.

restart.name: Restart
restart.explanation: Reloads the console. Use it to check whether the build has been replaced.

hint-language-switching.name: Hint Language Switching
hint-language-switching.explanation: Toggles the language displayed in the game.

hint-language-availability.name: Hint Language Availability
hint-language-availability.explanation: This is only valid if the author has prepared a translation.

hint-event-timing.name: Hint Event Timing
hint-event-timing.explanation: It triggers at specific times, such as when you return to the game or when you become gameovered.

hint-event-reward.name: Hint Event Reward
hint-event-reward.explanation: When activated, this screen will open, and the reward will be automatically granted along with a message.

hint-event-task.name: Hint Event Task
hint-event-task.explanation: A task is something you complete by meeting certain conditions, and you receive the reward yourself.

hint-debug-visibility.name: Hint Debug Visibility
hint-debug-visibility.explanation: It is displayed only during debugging.

hint-debug-publishing.name: Hint Debug Publishing
hint-debug-publishing.explanation: It will not be displayed when the game is published and distributed.

hint-config-settings.name: Hint Config Settings
hint-config-settings.explanation: Configure settings related to game display and processing.

hint-config-data.name: Hint Config Data
hint-config-data.explanation: Game data can be input/output and reset.

hint-statistics-progress.name: Hint Statistics Progress
hint-statistics-progress.explanation: You can check the progress of the game so far.

hint-overview-world.name: Hint Overview World
hint-overview-world.explanation: You can check about the world (world view, config) of this game.

hint-overview-console.name: Hint Overview Console
hint-overview-console.explanation: You can also check the console (system) that is running this game.

hint-correction-target.name: Hint Correction Target
hint-correction-target.explanation: You can see corrections for specific properties in this Category.

hint-correction-source.name: Hint Correction Source
hint-correction-source.explanation: Correction is due to the effect of the Item. You can check the item.

hint-properties-list.name: Hint Properties List
hint-properties-list.explanation: The following is a list of properties configured for each Category.

hint-properties-meaning.name: Hint Properties Meaning
hint-properties-meaning.explanation: A property is an element that affects the execution of an Action.

hint-properties-equipment.name: Hint Properties Equipment
hint-properties-equipment.explanation: The effect is corrected by Equipment of Item. (Some Items are Unnecessary)

hint-property-meaning.name: Hint Property Meaning
hint-property-meaning.explanation: A property is an element that affects the execution of an Action.

hint-property-calculation.name: Hint Property Calculation
hint-property-calculation.explanation: The final value is calculated from the assigned initial value, taking into account the level of the Category, the configured level of the Action, and the correction for the Item being equipped.

hint-trade-availability.name: Hint Trade Availability
hint-trade-availability.explanation: Some Items cannot be bought or sold.

hint-trade-locked.name: Hint Trade Locked
hint-trade-locked.explanation: Locked Items cannot be bought or sold.

hint-trade-limit.name: Hint Trade Limit
hint-trade-limit.explanation: There may be a limit on the number of purchases you can make for a given capacity or reservation slot (queue), and once you reach that limit, you will not be able to make any further purchases. (Increases resulting from rewards are not subject to this limit.)

hint-items-equipping.name: Hint Items Equipping
hint-items-equipping.explanation: Press and hold to toggle Equipment of Item.

hint-items-exclusive.name: Hint Items Exclusive
hint-items-exclusive.explanation: Only one Item in the list is Possible to equip. (If it is configured to be able to be equipped as a Category)

hint-items-locked.name: Hint Items Locked
hint-items-locked.explanation: Items that have not met the release requirements are locked and cannot be viewed in detail.

hint-item-meaning.name: Hint Item Meaning
hint-item-meaning.explanation: Items are elements related to owning things such as Equipment, Consumables, and Valuables.

hint-item-exclusive.name: Hint Item Exclusive
hint-item-exclusive.explanation: Only one Item in a Category is Possible to be equipped. (If it is configured to be able to be equipped as a Category)

hint-item-locked.name: Hint Item Locked
hint-item-locked.explanation: Items that have not met the release requirements are locked and cannot be viewed in detail.

hint-act-count.name: Hint Act Count
hint-act-count.explanation: You can specify the number of times to run it. Enter 0 to run until the resource runs out.

hint-queue-removing.name: Hint Queue Removing
hint-queue-removing.explanation: A long press on a bar removes it from the queue.

hint-actions-executing.name: Hint Actions Executing
hint-actions-executing.explanation: A long press toggles the execution of the Action.

hint-actions-exclusive.name: Hint Actions Exclusive
hint-actions-exclusive.explanation: Only one Item in a Category is Possible.

hint-actions-parallel.name: Hint Actions Parallel
hint-actions-parallel.explanation: Some Categories allow you to progress actions in more than one Category at the same time.

hint-actions-locked.name: Hint Actions Locked
hint-actions-locked.explanation: Actions that have not met the release conditions are locked and cannot be viewed in detail.

hint-action-experience.name: Hint Action Experience
hint-action-experience.explanation: Each act may gain experience value and will increase your level.

hint-action-resource.name: Hint Action Resource
hint-action-resource.explanation: Each act consumes or obtains an Item.

hint-action-locked.name: Hint Action Locked
hint-action-locked.explanation: Actions that have not met the release conditions are locked and cannot be viewed in detail.

hint-tasks-list.name: Hint Tasks List
hint-tasks-list.explanation: This is a list of the Tasks assigned to this Category.

hint-tasks-detail.name: Hint Tasks Detail
hint-tasks-detail.explanation: Select a Task to check its completion conditions and its reward.

hint-tasks-unclaimed.name: Hint Tasks Unclaimed
hint-tasks-unclaimed.explanation: A ribbon marks the Tasks whose reward has not been claimed yet. Select one and press claim to receive it.

hint-tasks-capacity.name: Hint Tasks Capacity
hint-tasks-capacity.explanation: You cannot claim a reward while the number of Item types you can hold is at its limit. Free up space and claim it again.

hint-tasks-empty.name: Hint Tasks Empty
hint-tasks-empty.explanation: This is not displayed when the Category has no Tasks at all.

hint-category-meaning.name: Hint Category Meaning
hint-category-meaning.explanation: This element is a compilation of Actions and Items.

hint-status-correction.name: Hint Status Correction
hint-status-correction.explanation: Only the value of the correction of the Category by Item is shown.

hint-status-action.name: Hint Status Action
hint-status-action.explanation: There are further other corrections depending on the Action to be performed.

hint-inventory-equipping.name: Hint Inventory Equipping
hint-inventory-equipping.explanation: Press and hold to toggle Equipment of Item.

hint-activity-executing.name: Hint Activity Executing
hint-activity-executing.explanation: A long press toggles the execution of the Action.

hint-missions-grouping.name: Hint Missions Grouping
hint-missions-grouping.explanation: The Tasks are grouped and displayed by Category.

hint-missions-ungrouped.name: Hint Missions Ungrouped
hint-missions-ungrouped.explanation: The Tasks with no Category configured are grouped together at the top.

hint-missions-completed.name: Hint Missions Completed
hint-missions-completed.explanation: A check mark is shown on the Tasks that have been completed.

hint-missions-unclaimed.name: Hint Missions Unclaimed
hint-missions-unclaimed.explanation: A ribbon marks the Tasks whose reward has not been claimed yet. Select one and press claim to receive it.

hint-missions-permanent.name: Hint Missions Permanent
hint-missions-permanent.explanation: Once a Task has been completed it stays completed, even if the conditions are no longer met afterwards.

hint-character-identical.name: Hint Character Identical
hint-character-identical.explanation: This content is identical to what is displayed by manipulating the Category.
